'''Prefect''' was a general title of power given to several officials throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], as well as among the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], who also had a [[High Prefect]]. An example of a prefect was that of the Yuuzhan Vong, [[Da'Gara]]. Yuuzhan Vong Prefects functioned as planetary governors and the commanders of [[Koros-Strohna|worldships]].
